component.name: Pulse
component.summary: Configurable resource meters for the COSMIC panel and dock

description.p: Monitor each logical CPU, RAM, swap, network traffic, disk space and I/O, and supported GPU utilization and memory with compact colored meters.
Configure visibility, refresh cadence, thresholds, bandwidth scales, network interface and disk mount point through cosmic-config.
Add compact CPU bars, CPU history with busiest-core tracking, and sample-driven peak afterglow.
Add manual Fedora RPM distribution and versioned changes.
